# JoeyC.ai

## Joey Colley

AI builder and content creator documenting the journey of building real apps with AI tools. Self-taught, not a traditional developer. Uses Claude, Lovable, and Replit to ship real products.

## Projects

- Luxvibe.io: Luxury hotel booking platform
- TitiLINKS: Bio link SaaS platform
- JoeyC.ai: Personal brand and AI education hub

## Content Focus

AI tools for beginners, building in public, app development tutorials.
